extension_subtopics.name: CLI history
extension_subtopics.future_use: Optional history, not current mechanism evidence.

bridges.title: Browser call, business effect and diagnostic summary
bridges.proposal: Map history/attempt/action to provider/context/tab generations and final arguments. Operation log remains best-effort telemetry; authoritative effect claims need separately scoped evidence. Post-send disconnect preserves unknown.
bridges.minimal_future_check: Wrapper success or missing diagnostic row never proves external completion; post-send disconnect stays unknown until qualified effect observation.

bridges.title: Lease, lifecycle and effect fencing
bridges.proposal: Verify all relevant writes enforce lease and trusted owner/instance binding. TTL/takeover/close only change future control eligibility; they neither undo accepted requests nor prove an old sender stopped.
bridges.minimal_future_check: Lease expiry leaves old in-flight effect unresolved; cleanup respects work ownership and evidence retention.

bridges.title: Authority, capability, page data and execution location
bridges.proposal: Bind final origin, object/argument revision, approval scope and location; apply current policy at use. Separate data audience and untrusted page content from authority; local guarantees do not transfer to A/B remote.
bridges.minimal_future_check: Changed target/object cannot reuse unrelated approval; disconnected driver is not executable capability. Preserve existing approval preference.

bridges.title: Versioned realtime input and late result applicability
bridges.proposal: Retain source span, version, provisional/stable status and acceptance time. Distinguish claims/decisions/AI hypotheses; correction supersedes assertions without granting authority or reversing effects. Recheck late results against current question/goal/watermark/audience.
bridges.minimal_future_check: Input, correction and late retrieval yield current traceable context; stale result remains historical and cannot overwrite current decision.

historical_document_gaps.finding: CONTRACTS/LIFECYCLE 0.2.21 / 3014180, LEASES 0.1.98, CAPABILITIES provider 0.1.87 / extension 0.1.86 are different historical baselines.
historical_document_gaps.resolution: Do not combine into one current capability snapshot.

historical_document_gaps.finding: CONTRACTS associates runId/callId with operation log; strict OPERATION-LOG schema omits them.
historical_document_gaps.resolution: Document mapping gap only; check fixed implementation before relying on resumable identity.

historical_document_gaps.finding: Earlier independent approval proposal and later follow-dsh decision coexist; hard-sensitive goals include unwired paths.
historical_document_gaps.resolution: Respect chronology and actual enforced policy; do not reinstate old default or add approval flow.

historical_document_gaps.finding: CONTEXTS section 6 says no chrome_verify, section 7 describes API; artifact directories differ.
historical_document_gaps.resolution: Do not infer complete assertion orchestration from documentation.
